title: dasylepis blackii

It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
